tips.text: Throw Boosted Ionic Charges the moment you find one and skip fighting; the capsule cannot be hurt or sped up by kills.
Run Ascension solo or in a premade; pub squads often ride the lift killing enemies instead of throwing charges.
Go back and check floors you passed for Boosted Ionic Charges; they spawn as the lift rises and do not despawn.
Look up at the start of the ride for the blue glow and grab all 3 Sister Beacons every run.
Bring a mobile frame such as Zephyr, Titania or Wukong to fetch Boosted Ionic Charges fast.
Carry a second charge with your Operator, and Void Sling to the lift before swapping back or it drops.
Bring Overguard or proc immunity, such as Dante, Frost or Revenant, because Jade Light Eximus stack Heat on you.
Run Steel Path if you can clear it; no Acolytes spawn here, so it adds no risk.
Banshee with Silence and a subsumed Gloom freezes the shaft and cuts runs to 3 or 4 minutes.
Stay away from the Sister if she rolls a Radiation weapon; it wipes pub squads.
Do not run Ascension for Sister gear; the Sister drops no Tenet weapon, Hound or Ephemera.
Spend motes on Harmony last; the blueprint can drop for free on any run.
Expect 7 to 10 minutes a run in public squads and 5 or 6 with a coordinated one.
Players call this farm boring rather than hard; the pity buy caps the grind.
